description:
I will teach you how to make the real Italian pasta from scratch. We will make some classic traditional pasta: "ravioli" , "fettuccine" and "tortelloni" . In addition to making homemade pasta we will prepare a different kind of sauces: Amatriciana or Carbonara, Butter and sage or tomato and basil for vegerarian. I will teach you everything you need to be able to make different types of pasta and sauces at home!
When we are finished we will cook, and eat our pasta together.
Making pasta from scratch is simple. The result will be surprising!
Then, the cooking class can begin!

Other things to note

* Inform me about any allergy or intolerance. If you would prefer a data that is different from ones published here, please contact me.
hostdescription:
Ciao! My name is Lucilla, I live in Rome with my husband and my two children.
When I'm home I take care to my family and cook Italian food like homemade Pasta.
I grew up with homemade pasta made by my grandmother. I love to share my passion and family's recipes and secrets with other people.
I would like to share with you this simple experience and teach you how to do it.

for photos and recipes follow me on Instagram @ fromzerotopasta_
locationDescription:
We will meet at my home. I live in the center of Rome near San Pietro near Castel Sant'Angelo.
We will start with n aperitif and then we will begin our lesson, in which you will be making your own hand made pasta. After the lesson we will cook together and we will share the dinner together.
I will give you the recipes that we will make and you can always write to get suggestions once you prepare the pasta at home.
I am waiting for you in Rome!

reviews.text: We had a lovely evening in Lucilla’s home making pasta. She was very friendly and encouraging and we learnt a lot about making pasta and 2 types of sauce. A lovely way to finish our time in Rome, and the pasta was delicious!

Lucille’s class is an absolute must. My 75yo mom, her BFF and I have been traveling Europe and we’re wrapping up our trip in Rome - so a pasta making class sounded perfect: we weren’t wrong, but that’s mainly because Lucilla and her partner made everything perfect. From the pecorino and honey to start, to the careful lesson on making pasta to the eye-opening secrets of herbs, we were literally oohing and aahing! We made a great new friend too, and let’s just say the pasta and sauce and ravioli were FANTASTIC!! Highly highly highly recommended.
My husband and I had such a great time with Lucilla and her husband. They were extremely welcoming and taught us so much about the food that we were making!

This cooking class was absolutely perfect. We actually learned a lot and Lucilla was the best teacher. I struggled a bit, haha, and she was patient and kind. This class wasn’t just a gimmicky “oh I took a cooking class in Italy.” I really do hope to go home and make yummy pasta, and I left feeling like I will actually be able to do that!! We were in a group with a family of two kids, and Lucilla was so patient and really good with them, helping them be just as involved in the process. Very family friendly. Also, the food we made was absolutely delicious.

This was such an exceptional experience!! My husband and I had a wonderful time with Lucilla and her husband, both of whom were so incredibly kind and welcoming, and just lovely people and hosts. Their home is beautiful, with bright open views of the city. We learned to make two different types of pasta, two sauces, and learned many tips and tricks to making both delicious (plus a few other tips in the kitchen!).

We left having made two new friends in Rome in Lucilla and her husband, wonderful memories, and new recipes to take home with us :) If you are visiting Rome, do not miss this!

A can’t miss fantastic experience. The food is as good as anywhere in Rome, Lucilla and her husband are kind and knowledgeable, and you learn a ton. I can’t think of a better way to spend part of my vacation in Rome.

As I reflect back on my trip to Italy, one thing I'm so thankful we did was take Lucilla's cooking class. Lucilla and her husband were such amazing hosts and made you feel like family while in their beautiful place. The pasta was amazing and the company was even better. I would definitely do this again if I were in Rome.

This experience was incredible! It was also cool to see the way she lives and an Italian apartment. The pasta was delicious and I loved learning how to fill and make the different pasta shapes; something we hadn’t tried on our own yet. She was super knowledgeable with the dough and shared lots of tips. It was a small group which I also really enjoyed. Don’t miss out and definitely take this class!
Great experience learning from a local. Was super fun and Lucilla was so nice. One of the best meals I ate in Italy!

Stop scrolling. Book this pasta making experience. Lucilla and her husband were such kind hosts. We started out the day with a few light snacks with espresso while we were making introductions and getting to know each other. We then hand made two different pastas and two different homemade pasta sauces. We then enjoyed the meal together with wine and followed with another espresso. She also sends you home with the recipes, so you can make them once you are home. Thank you so much Lucilla.

This class was amazing. Lucilla and her Husband Lorenzo were so kind and welcoming. Their home is beautiful and it was so cool to be in an authentic Italian home for the experience. She was a great teacher, made it fun, and the food was amazing. I’d recommend this to anyone traveling to Rome

I really enjoy learning how to make pasta from scratch from chef Lucilla. She is passionate about teaching and shares not only the recipe but the how and why in the making of pasta and delicious sauces. She makes it look so easy and doable! I can’t wait to cook for my family once im back in malaysia. 😍

Lucilla pasta making class was enjoyable and I love her story telling how she starts teaching pasta class and step by step pasta making. We requested for a vegan pasta class and she delivers it perfectly. The recipes were delicious and I look forward to sharing the skill she taught us back in Malaysia.

We took this cooking class with Lucilla and her husband and it was AMAZING. The best experience so far while in Rome. We booked this class as a family 7, 2 being children aged 2 and 4. Lucille and her family were so patient with them as you can imagine toddlers are a bit unpredictable. We had a blast during this class and I will be telling all my friends and family what an amazing time we had and hopefully using the skills we learned to make pasta for them too!
This was a great experience! Lucilla was an excellent teacher, and we learned so much about the traditions of making pasta. Very fun activity in a gorgeous home!

Oh my gosh Lucilla and hee husband are amazing people and great hosts! So warm and welcoming. Wonderful to see a Roman apartment. We learned so much about making and cooking pasta! Fabulous night! They were amazing.

Absolutely amazing experience. Lucilla taught my friend and me how to make 2 dishes of fresh pasta and told us the secrets of making authentic pasta. You would also get a recipe after the class that you could make your own when you go back home.

Also, Lucilla was so welcoming and friendly. Even though I booked the class at the very last minute like 11 pm the night before, she still confirmed the booking and went to the market very early morning to prepare for the class.

This cooking class is definitely one of my favourite experiences in Rome!
Great experience. She was so patient with us and we made so many different types of pasta. She was able to accommodate my dietary restrictions. Must do in Rome!

this experience is one of the greatest highlights of my Italy trip! my friends and I had such a lovely time making pasta and new friends. the smaller intimate group size gave us each a chance to participate in making other elements of the dish together and lucille was able to really give each person the attention and assistance we needed.

lucille and her family were extremely kind, personal, and patient during the whole process!

and the food was amazing!! lucille picked the freshest ingredients and it was all so so delicious. she provided the recipe and t
included tips along the way.

please do yourself a favor and book with Lucille! she's the sweetest and best!

Lucilla and her husband are the best! We had such a heart-warming welcome and Lucilla showed us how to make great pasta. Lucilla is amazing!
She and her husband were so amazing hosts. We felt so welcome at their beautiful home. The class was very informational, she really walked us through all the steps of making pasta. We had nice wines along with it and good fun conversations. We Highly recommend!

This was a great experience, Lucilla had a beautiful home that was great for this class. The experience was fun and easy, anyone could do it. We were greeted with great appetizers as well. The class size was great as well, large enough for conversation and small enough for good instruction. The final product was delicious and I will absolutely be making the recipes again. We had the best time!! Lucilla is a lovely teacher and created a fun and comfortable environment to make pasta! I highly recommend this experience and can’t wait to return the next time I’m in Rome. :)

This cooking class was such a great experience. We are a family of 4 with two teenagers. Lucilla makes sure everyone is able to get hands on experience from making the pasta to the sauces. I think the small class size, 6 people, is also excellent because it allows for the possibility to ask questions and Lucilla was able to go around to each of us to offer help as needed. This is a fantastic experience! I participated with my 10 and 12 year old and we all had a lovely time. I highly recommend booking this experience! Lucilla did an amazing job explaining everything step by step and the end results were amazing. Plus, the company was great and hearing Lucilla talk about growing up in Italy was really cool. You won’t regret this experience!
Wonderful cooking class, Lucilla was friendly, patient,informative and very skilled at her craft. More than anything she made you feel welcome and likes old friend.

This was an incredible experience! We learned a lot about pasta preparation and gained a whole new appreciation for the art of pasta making. My mother and I enjoyed this experience so much! Lucilla hosted us in her home, which was tucked away in a more quiet area of Rome close to the Vatican. Perfect experience. The Hosts try very hard to make it a perfect night and they did. Very well thought out, and the hosts were extremely friendly and inviting. I would recommend this to anyone staying in Rome.

We just finished six days of vacationing in Rome with our two teenage daughters (15+17) and this was the best experience of the entire trip.

I guarantee you that this will be the one experience that we will remember and talk about for years to come.

Lucilla welcomes you into her home and heart by sharing her recipes, suggestions and love of Italian cooking! We learned so much…. This is a must-do pasta making experience!!!

Beautiful experience that we recommend 1000%!! One of our favorite memories from our trip to Rome. Lucilla is lovely, the atmosphere is very friendly all night with the other participants. It was a great cooking class! The atmosphere was very warm and inviting. During this class I met other travelers and exchanged tips/ideas for what to do in Rome. Would definitely recommend!

Such a great experience! Lucilla and her husband were very hospitable and patient with our lack of skills. Lucilla and family were wonderful hosts. Never have I made pasta and I am so glad I booked this class. I learned fettuccine and revioli. Lucilla's pasta making class is really great! If you are interested in learning how to make fresh pasta and classic Roman sauces, this is a perfect class. Lucilla was personable, knowledgeable and easy to understand for English speakers. The class was well formatted and we had so much fun. We made new friends, made pasta, made the sauce and fillings. We had a wonderful evening and a delicious cooking experience. The host was super kind and well organized. We had a great diner after that :)

We had such an amazing time learning how to make pasta with Lucilla and her husband. Lucilla is an expert pasta chef and she will make sure you come out of there decent yourself! The pasta was so good and we learned a lot! Can’t wait to cook the same at home.

The class was absolutely amazing! Lucilla and her husband are the sweetest! Lucilla explains everything perfectly and is there to help you every step of the way. I loved the class and I would come back for another class anytime!

This experience was a wonderful way to spend an evening in Rome. Lucille was so welcoming, warm, and accommodating. She was also very knowledgeable, and taught us several different pasta making techniques. I would absolutely recommend!

We had a great one on one experience. Lucilla and her husband were great hosts who made us feel welcome in their home and taught us some great recipes and techniques for making pasta. Great start to our trip in Rome.

The class was AMAZING! Lucille and her husband were so welcoming and allowed us into their home to teach us traditions of Rome through pasta making! She was so informative and passionate! A must do while in Rome!

Lucilla and her partner were so thoughtful and generous all through the evening. It was such a wonderful way to spend an evening in Italy and cannot recommend it enough. Would absolutely go again if I were ever to go back!

It was a great experience. They were both very kind. Lucilla showed us every step to cook pasta. It all started with excellent appetizers. Lucilla was such a joy to meet. She welcomed us into her home, introduced us to her husband is a delight to talk to while he helped her in the kitchen.

This was definitely a highlight of our trip to Italy! My husband and I were lucky to have Lucilla and her husband all to ourselves. Everything was amazing, from the appetizers to the wine, and the pasta making. An experience we’ll never forget.

Let me just start by saying my girlfriend and I definitely learned more than what was expected. Lucilla and her husband (sou chef) were incredible hosts. With our gratitude,
Robert & Jeanette

Look no further when it comes to choosing a cooking class in Rome. You've found it! Lucilla's home was clean and inviting. The class was well organized, informative and provided an environment for casual conversation and a wonderful hands-on experience. She was kind, enthusiastic, helpful and made us feel welcome. The food was yummy! We made ravioli, fettuccine and two sauces. Antipasta and drinks were also provided,which was unexpected. My friend and I don't drink alcohol, and another guest was vegetarian. Lucilla accommodated these situations with no issues.

I really enjoyed this class. I highly recommend it and would go back to see her again for another cooking experience if I return to Rome. I also really admired the respect and team work between Lucilla and her husband, who assisted her throughout the evening. It was lovely evening in their home.

We had such a fantastic evening meeting Lucilla and her husband. I have been to a couple of pasta classes before, but this is the first time I have felt super confident. She is a great teacher, the food was outstanding, and she was so organized.

HIGHLY RECOMMEND! A wonderful experience for home cooks of all skill levels. Lucilla patiently walked us through each and every step of the process, and it was so fun seeing it all come together. Lucilla clearly selected each of the ingredients with care (many of which came from a fresh, local market that very morning), and all of the food was incredible! Lucilla and her husband were so warm and inviting that we instantly felt like we were enjoying an evening with old friends. Do not pass this up!

Lucilla was very kind and friendly, i learned a lot about How to prepare Pasta in Italian way. And she was understanding about the special request from my side in regards to pork meat. Over all it was a great experience with a good teacher.

As a professional chef, learning more about true “Roman” style of making pasta from true “Roman” lady in the center of Roma city was very special experience, but sharing meal that we prepared together and having a deep conversation with Lucilla and her husband Renzo was unforgettable.

I felt very welcomed, cared, homey and grateful. They even gave me personal recommendations for restaurants to go, places to visit for the rest of my trip.

The whole experience was professional, but very personal like I found my lost family at the same time. I can’t recommend the experience enough for those who love cooking, or want to try something new and special on their holidays in Rome.

Lucilla and Renzo, I can’t wait to welcome you both in my restaurant in Korea one day in a close future!

If you want a true experience in the heart of Roma: don't hesitate! We had a great evening with Lucilla, her husband and the other guests and we felt like we were at a friends dinner. The class was great, the food delicious, the place very nice. If you're looking for a great evening with italians, learning how to cook and enjoying a nice dinner, you found it!

Making pasta with Lucilla and her partner was a truly wonderful experience. They were both so warm and inviting. They had a lovely aperitivo prepared and making pasta was a low pressure skill building activity. I will definitely be doing this back at home for friends and family. The final dishes were delicious but the most fun to be had was getting to know Lucilla, her partner and our fellow pasta making friends. Her home was beautiful and had a gorgeous view. If you’re looking for a cozy way to learn about Italy, their culture and the day to day life of an Italian this is the experience for you! Thank you for the wonderful evening Lucilla!
We had a wonderful evening with Lucilia and her husband. We learned how to make fresh pasta, had a lovely dinner, and parted ways as friends. Highly recommend the experience!

Lucilla and her husband are very friendly and open. Lucilla explained everything to me slowly and took the time, even though I was the only guest. Thanks so much for the new information! I can really recommend the class.

The very first cooking class turned out to be one of my best traveling experiences so far! I recommend it to everyone who’s eager to discover new things while visiting Rome.
My friend and I booked this class in advance and couldn’t wait to finally be there. Let me tell you, it was AMAZING!
Lucilla took her time to teach us the techniques of cooking homemade colored pasta and it was obvious she was very passionate about it. We made wonderful and delicious pasta and ravioli starting from zero, tried 3 different colors(curcuma, beetroot and spinach), many different pasta types(fettuccine, farfalle, etc) and different ways to make them. We also learned to make filling for ravioli(spinach & ricotta) and sauce for amatriciana. Discovered many interesting things about Rome as well. It was super fun! I also want to thank Lucilla for going out of her way to organize this class for us, we really appreciate her efforts and we will definitely tell our friends and family about her classes. Would love to come back one day. Gracie!!!
P.S. Also, all covid prevention measures were respected!

It was a great experience! Lucilla and her husband were so nice and welcoming. They have a beautiful Italian home with a great view. The pasta class was great. We really did our own pasta in different styles from scratch. What an unique experience. We can highly recommend this activity to learn something about Roman cuisine. Thank you Lucilla!

A fabulous and fun experience which made our trip a bit more interesting! All ingredients were laid out on table in Lucilla’s beautiful home. We made two different types of pasta and sauces, which Lucilla cooked and we then ate together. We can’t wait to have a go at making pasta ourselves at home, with help from Lucilla’s recipe. Would recommend to anyone staying in Rome 😊! Thank you very much. X

This experience was unique. We learned a lot, as it was easy to follow lucillas instructions. She and her husband made us feel at home. Furthermore, the pasta were delicious! We can recommend this pasta class entirely!

This was such an awesome part of our trip to Rome! Eating pasta in the restaurants are great, but understanding the work that goes into making it fresh, really gives you a new appreciating for it. Lucilla and her husband were personable and made us feel super comfortable in their home and making pasta. I felt like I left knowing way more than I expected. It was fun and enjoyable, while also educational and skillful. You definitely want to learn how to make pasta from Lucilla!

Lucilla and Lorenzo made us so welcome in their beautiful home. The pasta making class was an amazing experience where we learnt so much but also felt like we made new friends. Thank you so much for having us in your hone and I would definitely recommend others to give this a try.

Lucilla and her husband were incredibly welcoming and accomodating (veggie and gluten free!) and the food was excellent. She can answer all questions you might have about pasta making and the location of the apartment is super central - highly recommended!

Lucilla is so welcoming and warm that you immediately feel at a friends house. Pasta runs in her family and she surprised us with excellent knowledge and techniques to make our own pasta. After making the fresh pasta and two different sauces, we sat down with her to eat and have a glass of really nice wine and had a wonderful evening. If you want to know how to prepare delicious fresh pasta by hand (no machine), feel at home with friends in a precious central Rome Appartment and share some stories with new friends, this experience is for you!

Due to very good communication before that, the beautiful building in the Lucilla and her husband was very easy to find and we were warmly welcomed. Every participant had their own "workplace" and could really try every step of their own (dough, roll out, cut tagliatelle and fill the ravioli). We then all made the sauce or the filling together in the kitchen. After everything was ready, we ate with Lucilla and her husband. It was a great,happy evening with interesting conversations and encounters! Clear recommendation!

Fantastic small group setting for learning a new skill. Lucilla is very knowledgable and really wants you to learn to be able to recreate these meals at home. This was a lovely experience I would recommend to any pasta lovers.

It was a great experience! Lucilla was extremely knowledgeable, as well as helpful with showing us how to make pasta. She made us all feel very welcome into her home, and overall provided an easy, fun experience for our small group. I would definitely recommend!

We had a wonderful family evening with Lucilla and her husband. My husband our daughters and I were able to learn a lot about homemade pasta and Lucilla helped with all the steps to make our perfect noodles. I joined the pasta class we had a nice dinner and best entertainment. We loved meeting Abdullah and his daughter from Saudi Arabia.

Lucilla welcomed us into her home as if we were family. More than four hours between the workshop and dinner that has been spent with both us and the children. Highly recommended!

Great experience! Lucille and her husband are very attentive and completely adapted to the group. We definitely felt like we were invited to a friend's house!
We learned how to make ricotta dumplings - spinach (then cooked with butter + sage) and fettuncini (with tomato sauce). Dinner was also very nice, in a very nice apartment.

Lucilla and her husband were beyond welcoming. My family so enjoyed our evening together. We learned great recipes that I will carry with me forever. Highly recommend!

We had a very nice evening in a small circle. Lucilla taught us a lot about making pasta and helping us with all the work steps. Finally, we tasted our creations together.
It was a very successful evening!

This was simply outstanding. Lucilla and her husband welcomed my family of 6 into their home and treated us like friends. We shared stories and learned about her background regarding pasta making. She and her husband made it so fun for all of us and made special accommodations for our vegetarian. They were friendly, warm, inviting, and kind. I couldn't recommend this experience more highly.

Let me start by saying that this was our first experience booking with air B and B. Lucilla and her husband were so gracious, welcoming and accommodating of my gluten intolerance along with my vegetarian diet. I couldn’t recommend her cooking class enough. Not only did we learn a host of techniques to make pasta but we also learned how to make a very simple pasta sauce base that I’m sure all of us will use often in our own kitchens.

The experience itself was intimate so no one was rushed, and Lucilla was able to give extra attention to my husband and his struggling technique (he was such a good sport).

Her home is in a location very close to the Vatican so fairly easy to get to and everything was very clean and tidy. So much so, I almost forgot I was cooking in someone’s home rather than a restaurant or something. Go book your experience with confidence. Lucilla and Lorenzo will not disappoint.
Ciao

Lucilla radiated warmth from the moment I arrived for the class. She has a thoughtful, deliberate approach about her and made the learning experience fun...and tasty. I can't wait to try to recreate this delicious pasta (and the accompanying sauces) at home. Thank you, Lucilla!
Genuine experience of preparing a pasta meal. I felt like this is how her grandmother taught her to make pasta the right way.

We enjoyed the small group and the personal touches of learning to make home made pasta in Lucilla and Renzo's home. We also greatly appreciate that Lucilla really wanted us to learn how to make pasta, do it ourselves, and be successful in our efforts. She was passionate about teaching us. If you are looking for a party-like experience, look elsewhere. If you want to have a really enjoyable experience learning how to make pasta from lovely people - and also eat it- book this experience.

It was a lot of fun! It's an experience in English, but it's an experience that Koreans can fully enjoy! And Lucila and her husband welcomed us warmly and were attentive! As I learned, I really want to make it at home again!!!

A wonderful evening of learning new skills. I was able to share this experience with my daughter to continue a family tradition of passing down Italian traditions. We felt very welcomed and hopefully can take these skills back home to cook pasta for our whole family!

We had a lively time with Lucilla and her husband. The group was small which allowed for a personalized class. Lucilla was very passionate and knowledgeable and a great teacher. I loved it and can t wait to try to make it again at home. Thanks a lot! Carolina

Lucilla was very hospitable and made sure everyone felt at ease and connected to the group. We cooked together using fresh ingredients. Lucilla was a great teacher and I now feel like I can start making pasta easily at home. It was a real pleasure and I highly recommend this to anybody who wants to learn how to make pasta in Rome.

My husband and I came back to Rome for our 5 year wedding anniversary - we first came on our honeymoon! This time around, we were determined to do less touristy items and enjoy more of the Italian culture and that's when we found Lucilla and her pasta making class in Rome. It was TRULY wonderful. She's so kind, teaches you how to make the different pastas with ease and bonus - we learned how to make two different sauces to go with the pasta. It was one of our highlights of our trip. The location was also great and it was intimate being that it was in her home. It was truly special. Lucilla is also just a wonderful and kind human and it was a pleasure to get to know her and be welcomed into her home.

That's really cool! You won't regret it, you can book without thinking! 3 hours flew like one! Lucilla and her husband, amazing, very pleasant to communicate with. Very detailed step-by-step master class, now we will try to cook it at home;) thank you very much, you will remain a wonderful memory of Rome;)

This experience was a great way to start our trip in Italy. Lucilla and her husband were very welcoming in their cozy home. They were very friendly and patient in teaching the group. I would highly recommend this experience for those of you who want to learn how to cook authentic pasta and enjoy yourselves while learning!
We had a great time and the pasta we made was amazing! Lucille makes everything very clear. I will definitely use her teaching to make pasta in the future

Learning to hand make pasta and prepare different sauces with Lucilla was such a unique and incredible experience. She was very knowledgeable and her passion for cooking and tradition really showed. I would highly recommend this experience!

Cooking pasta with Lucilla and her husband was fun, educational and produced delicious results! They were happy answering my questions about technique, ingredients and Italian food culture. I felt welcomed into their home (in a beautiful 19th C building) and was immediately offered starters and a glass of wine. Lucilla and her husband created a warm, friendly atmosphere and I ended up hanging out with my classmates well beyond the class itself. Good food, wine, conversation and company - a perfect evening!

This was an amazing experience, and I definitely recommend it! The small group and personalized experience felt very special. It felt like Lucilla and her husband really wanted to learn about us and and we all had fun swapping travel stories. And of course the pasta (and wine) was delicious!

It was a great experience! Lucilla and her husband made us feel very welcome in her home and we had a lot of fun with them and the other participants. The class itself was very interesting and the Pasta and sauces delicious. Highly recommend! Thank you Lucilla and Enzo!

My partner and I SO enjoyed this experience with Lucilla and her husband. Their beautiful home was a perfect place to learn about traditional Italian pasta styles. We ended up being more than a half an hour late (Thanks Rome buses!!) but Lucilla and the other guests waited for us to begin. We had aperitif and some wine to start and created two versions of a pasta dish, including one non traditional (americanized) dish, which Lucilla had grown up with. We loved taking turns helping with the creation of the sauces and pastas and working with the whole group. Lucilla was a fantastic teacher and I know that we’ll use her techniques again very soon! We had great dinner conversation and fantastic wine with our freshly made pasta. Overall, such an amazing experience and so glad we did it!
We had so much fun making pasta with new friends. Lucilla was an expert and very kind. We left with happy hearts and stomachs full of delicious pasta! What a great night!

Wonderful evening spent learning how to make homemade pasta. Lucilla and her husband were welcoming hosts and very knowledgeable about pasta making. Location close to city center and easy to find. Definitely enjoyed the class, hosts, and the pasta!

Lucilla was a great host who took time to interact with everyone at the event. She seemed to genuinely care about her guest and went above and beyond to make each person feel welcome. She was also a wonderful teacher that always waiting until everyone completely understood each step involved with pasta making before moving on with the lesson.

I recommend this experience to anyone interested in having a great night out in Rome.
Lucille was very suite & genuinely seemed to enjoy teaching the class. Everything was very organized & well set up. I would love to do again if given the chance :)
A wonderful pasta making class taught by a lovely host. She gives clear step by step instructions that were very easy to follow and made everyone feel very welcome in her home.
I would definitely recommend this experience! Lucilla was so welcoming and great at showing us all the steps to making delicious pasta and I can’t wait to try making it again at home!

We had an absolutely delightful experience making pasta with Lucilla! She was so friendly and interested in making our experience the best it could be. I would definitely recommend this experience to group of friends looking for an authentic Italian meal and unique experience.

When I signed up for this class, I was a little apprehensive due to the fact that I am celiac. However, when informing Lucilla (beforehand), she went above and beyond having gluten free flour, a sanitary area, and being very mindful of contamination when coming from helping other people in the class. I could not have asked for a better, more accommodating experience, and I am so so glad that I decided to take part in this experience. I highly recommend this class and will be dreaming about the pasta and ravioli we made until the day I die :)
Lucilla was a great teacher and the pasta was delicious! Lucilla and her husband made us feel welcome in their home. Definitely recommend this experience!

Lucilla and her husband were amazing hosts. My friends and I are study abroad students and Lucilla and her husband gave us the sense of home we were missing during the holiday season. We made pasta and learned about Italy's traditional dishes for families. The ravioli and carbonara were AMAZING with the homemade sauce and filling and we took away the skills to make pasta when we return home to our families. We ate a meal together and talked about our family holidays in our respective countries. Lucilla and her husband were so friendly and genuinely interested in our experience. Highly highly recommend this sweet family!!! <3

This really is a MUST DO experience if you're in Rome! I went in to this expecting to make some hopefully tasty pasta but came out with so much more. The experience was more akin to being in a wonderful and lovely intimate dinner party with friends.

Lucilla's place is beautiful and very charming. I went with a new friend who I had met the night before on an AirBnB walking tour and we were with a couple from England who were very sweet and friendly. Lucilla and her husband were so welcoming and so genuinely sweet making us all feel so comfortable. The pasta making was so much fun and moreover, the experience of spending time in an authentic Italian home with a lovely couple and new people who were just as nice and friendly made this a very magical night. It was so much fun that we lost track of time but at no point were we made to feel hurried by Lucilla and her husband.

It's truly a unique experience that can't be replicated in a restaurant setting which offers a similar pasta-making experience. Also, the pasta turned out very tasty which made the night even more special. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND - it's truly a very special experience and infinitely more than just simply making pasta!
Lucilla and her husband were absolutely incredible and welcoming. Our group had so much fun learning how to make pasta - and it was delicious! Highly recommend this experience.

If you’re thinking about booking this, DO IT! Lucilla is amazing - warm, friendly, patient and informative. We really felt like we learned a lot, and had so much fun learning about pasta, Rome, and Italian culture.

She was great at accommodating my food allergy, going out of her way to buy me special lactose free ricotta cheese so that I could still make ravioli and specifically bought multiple lactose free cheeses for me. I was so excited to be able to fully participate in the experience, and so blown away by her thoughtfulness to make sure I didn’t miss out on anything.

From the moment we walked in we were made to feel very welcome. Lucilla and her husband taught us well, were fun and relaxed and took us step by step to produce a yummy supper. It was only after we had left that we realised we were about an hour over our time (sorry Lucilla, we didn't realise how late it was!) - time flies by when you are having fun.

From the square to the beautiful home where we were welcomed with a warm atmosphere, the experience is highly recommended, both in terms of the course and the human interaction with the lovely hosts and other guests. It was a memrebla experience and the final results where simply put fantastic.
A definite must do!!

This is a really fun, unique experience. I would recommend it to anyone who wants an interactive, personal lesson, and something different from the regular sightseeing. Lucilla and her husband were very welcoming and after learning how to make pasta, a sauce and a ravioli filling, we all sat down to have dinner together; it was like a private dinner party at someone’s house. There were two other ladies from different corners of the world that were also on the course so this made it an interesting evening getting to know them and sharing our various life stories. It was a great evening. My 12 year old had a particularly good time and has since requested a pasta machine for Christmas! But we couldn’t keep him waiting that long, so it’s arriving tomorrow!

What a wonderful evening! This experience was a true highlight of my month-long stay in Rome. Lucilla and her husband were so welcoming and kind to us all. They had an aperitivo waiting for us upon arrival and we got to chat and get to know one another for a bit. The other guests participating made the evening that much memorable as well! The pasta lesson was such a fun learning experience- from the dough, to the sauces, preparation, and everything in between. Enjoying it all over a lovely dinner was the perfect end to the night!

The pasta making class with Lucilla was 100% authentic and the best meal we had during our whole trip! We loved exchanging stories and discussing various American/Italian ways of life with Lucilla and her husband. It was truly a unique and unforgettable experience that I would highly recommend to anyone visiting Rome!

We had a wonderful time learning new skills that we will take home with us. The food was delicious and it was a very relaxing evening. Our 11 year old twins were able to participate fully and enjoyed it as much as we did!

This was a great experience. Lucilla provides good wine, good food, and good company all in her beautiful home. I would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a hands on activity that will leave you with happy memories whenever you make pasta again.
Great and memorable experience for our final night in Rome. Lucilla is an expert at making pasta and made this experience feel personal. We will be bringing these recipes back home with us!

It was in a wonderful experience of Roman hospitality and culinary culture. Lucilla was very well prepared and introduced us to the "pasta world" piece by piece. It was a great evening with nice people in a cozy atmosphere. Definitely recommended!

This is a must-do while in Rome. Learning how to make the pasta and enjoying it was quite amazing. Best pasta we’ve had yet on our trip! Lucilla was very knowledgeable and helpful throughout the process, and we met some great people!

Such a great class! It was truly special to be welcomed into their home. Lucilla made it such a once in a lifetime experience! She even accommodated a gluten-free need for our friend and made sure she felt fully included with her adapted pasta making! It was just wonderful!

This pasta making class with Lucilla was absolutely wonderful. It was very personal and a small group - about six people in the class. We learned how to make homemade ravioli and fetuccini and Lucilla and her husband were absolutely wonderful. They made sure everyone was comfortable and were so accommodating! We felt like part of the family. Definitely would recommend!
This class was amazing! Lucilla was very knowledgable and patient with me, even though I was a complete beginner! Thank you for a great experience!

Great evening learning how to make pasta at Lucille’s home. Easy to find and we were made feel very welcome. We learnt a lot about pasta making and the finished meal was absolutely delicious! Would highly recommend this experience.
We spent a wonderful evening with Lucille and her husband making pasta. It felt so authentic sharing great food, wine and conversation with new friends. I would highly recommend this experience.

Lucilla was such a wonderful teacher and very friendly host. She opened up her home to my friends and I and we had such a great experience. She was very well prepared! She had laid out delicious appetizers for us to eat at the beginning of class and made sure we felt welcome. The pasta making experience was so fun and very hands on. We are the pasta that we made and it was delicious! This class was definitely one of our favorite experiences in Rome and we highly recommend her class to anyone in the area!

Lucilla and her spouse were very welcoming to our group of 4. There was one other couple that was in the class, making it an intimate class of 6. We felt very comfortable in her home as it was very spacious and clean. Lucilla is very knowledgable and explained everything easily for us. They also played Queen which was a bonus for me. As someone who doesn’t have a lot of great cooking ability, Lucille gave me hope that I can be a better cook. I highly recommend this class to anyone visiting Rome!
My friends and I took this class and had the best time! Lucilla and her husband were incredibly welcoming! Would highly recommend this class!

One of our favorite experiences in Rome! Lucilla and her husband are truly wonderful and made us feel right at home. We not only learnt how to make home-made pasta and two accompanying sauces, but we also had a lovely evening cooking and eating, drinking wine and learning about everyone present. Felt more like a dinner with friends than a class, with the benefit of also learning traditional Italian pasta making techniques. Highly recommended!!
The evening was very nice. We've been able to try every step of the pasta. The hosts were super nice. Everything tasted very good.

We had a wonderful cooking class with Lucilla and her husband. They welcomed us into their home and taught us how to make delicious pasta. It was great that it was only 6 people as it made it very intimate. We will definitely take our skills back home and I’m so glad we got to meet them.

Truly one of the most amazing experiences! They were so open and welcome, it felt like home! Lucilla truly has the art of pasta down! It was incredible to learn from her. I really want to see if i can do it at home now!
Lucille's experience made the end of our Rome stay perfect. Her and her husband were excellent hosts and taught us how to make pasta while making it all very enjoyable!

Had an amazing time, my husband even enjoyed it too- Lucilla and her husband are very welcoming, you feel like you are having a fun night with friends!! I learned so much and the food was amazing, soo glad I booked this- it made our trip to Rome extra special!!

Lucilla and her husband welcomed us into their home with open arms. They were so friendly and kind, it was wonderful to be able to immerse ourselves in their culture. The pasta making class was well-organized, interactive, and super fun! They were kind enough to serve delicious appetizers and there was plenty of wine and water for the entire evening. Lucilla showed us how to make several different pastas, and the sauces we made were delicious. I would highly recommend this experience to anyone visiting Rome, who has a love for pasta and enjoys meeting new people.

What an amazing time! Lucilla and her husband put on a great experience in teaching our group how to make some traditional Italian pasta dishes. We did everything from making the dough to creating different noodles and of course the sauce to top the dishes off. Once the meal was prepared, we sat down and enjoyed the food with some great company and got to learn a bit about Lucilla, her husband, and some of their life experiences. Lucilla was even kind enough to offer a delicious dessert after our meal! I would recommend to anyone looking for a fun, traditional Italian event while in Rome!

Perfect experience! Both culinary and human. We have been received in a family, with easy going and welcome attitude, it was also a great culinary experience, that I will be able to reproduce at home!! A lot of tips and good food!

This was an incredible experience. Lucille really knows what she’s teaching. She helped us all make great pasta and two types of sauce. We ate and drank well and all got to know each other. Would definitely recommend to anyone.
Absolutely amazing experience. Lucilla is a nice and warm host, who make everybody feel good. Excellent cooking class and great taste! Very very recommending
I really recommend this experience with Lucilla. She is kind, patient and knows how to make people feel comfortable! I really had a great time Thanks again!
A really enjoyable evening spent with Lucilla in her home. Made very welcome, she helped with the tricky parts !! Very nice food at the end of it. Really good company all round. Thanks everyone 😊😊

This was one of family’s favorite experiences is Rome. Lucilla’s pasta class was a lot of fun and very enjoyable. My husband and I and our 2 children (15 & 10) were really engaged and excited to participate. Lucilla’s experience come from generations of knowledge and she loves sharing the recipes with her guests. She really makes you feel like a master chef!
Also, she opened her home and was very kind and courteous. I felt very welcomed into her home.
Lucilla and her husband were amazing hosts.
I would totally do it again.

Lucilla and her husband Renzo were incredible hosts and teachers. I truly felt immersed in a traditional Roman home along with Lucilla's stories about what is done traditionally in Roman culinary cuisine. The recipes were authentic and delicious! I would highly recommend this Air BnB experience.
Such an amazing experience! I went home and made pasta for my family and they loved it. Learning how to make pasta in such an intimate setting was wonderful.

Lucilla’s pasta cooking class was truly one of the best parts of our trip to Rome. Lucilla and her husband Renzo were incredibly welcoming into their beautiful home. The class starts with simply chatting with the hosts and getting to know each other over a large array of delicious Italian appetizers (all prepared by Lucilla) and wine. Then the cooking begins, and Lucilla makes it instructional, easy, and fun. We learned to make different shapes of pasta both by hand and with a machine, and then we learned how to make two different pasta sauces for two dishes that we ate together in what really felt like a dinner with old friends. Highly recommend this cooking class to anyone not only wanting to learn how to make (delicious!) homemade pasta, but also looking for a warm and memorable evening of great conversation and wonderful company!

Incredible evening with Luca and her husband! I would have never believed that my husband would enjoy making pasta and sauce from scratch himself. It was a hands on experience with 6 people and our hosts in their home! This was such a fun way to kick off our fiat trip to Italy!

I had an absolutely delightful time with Lucilla. I felt welcome & comfortable in her home. It was clean & inviting. The process of making the pasta was a lot of fun. Lucilla made sure we all followed along & were in the right track. The best part was enjoying the meal together while getting to know one another. I would definitely do this again if I ever come back to Rome. There was not only the cooking class, but also some tips about the area. Highly recommend!

We were a group of 6 guests - felt like the right number of people. Lucilla was patient with everyone and she made sure everyone knew what they were doing. You can tell that she has a big passion for Italian cooking. The whole experience was perfect and the spinach ravioli and carbonara we made were absolutely delicious! . A big thank-you to Lucilla and her husband for opening up her home to us. During and after dinner we sat around talking and ended up staying at their house until after 11pm. They were not in a rush to get people out and you can tell that they genuinely are interested in talking to people from around the world.
Must do experience! Lucilla is very patient and thorough in her approach to equip you with a skill set you can take home. We had a great night and the company made it very enjoyable.

It was the best experience I could have asked for! So welcoming from the moment we stepped in, to the end of the night when Lucilla helped to call us a cab, after we were full from delicious pasta, that we actually made by hand. Would definitely recommend to anyone visiting Rome!

This was an amazing experience. Lucilla was fantastic and her husband really helpful as well for the whole experience. We are excited to go back and make our own pasta.

The group we were with was super fun as well. It was nice to have a group of Americans there with us as well.

Seriously, don’t second guess this experience just book it! So much fun! Anyone that comes to Italy we will recommend this.

Thank you Lucilla!

My daughter and I took a paste making class with Lucilla and it was one of the top highlights of our trip. Lucilla was so patient with our questions and was an excellent teacher. She made sure that each of us received the help that we needed at each step of the pasta class. When making the sauces for the dishes Lucilla let us make it in her kitchen. Everything is hands on for this class, which I prefer. The class is very small which I loved. The other guess were so much fun to work with and socialize with. After everything was made we all sat down together and ate the delicious food we made. Lucilla’s husband worked behind the scenes while Lucilla helped us. They made a perfect pair. I looked at a lot of pasta classes, but this one was the one that stood out to me. I am so glad we took this class. Thank you Lucilla for such a wonderful and most memorable time. If I am ever in Rome again I would love to learn how to make other pasta’s with you.

Being invited into Lucilla’s home was one of the best experiences we could have ever hoped for. In Rome you can be bombarded with ‘touristy’ things to do. This was the opposite. Lucilla was genuine, kind and professional. She shares a real talent, love and care for her classes. I had never done an Airbnb experience before and this really exceeded all expectations! Thank you Lucilla! We now have a memory and skills for life!
Pasta making was a wonderful experience for me and my family. We enjoyed the evening and will try to make pasta from scratch now that we are home. Loved it! Lucille is an excellent host.

Our entire group agreed that pasta making with Lucilla and her husband was one of the highlights of our trip to Italy. The class is held in Lucilla's home and we had the opportunity to learn several different methods for making pasta and pasta sauce. We also got to enjoy appetizers, dessert, and wine throughout the evening. Lucilla was very accommodating to a food allergy from one of our group members. She and her husband were so welcoming and all we can say is "grazie" for the fantastic experience!

Lucilla made us feel very welcome in her home, a beautiful location close to the Vatican. She is a wonderful cook and taught us the basics very well. The cooking of pasta, the dinner together with personal stories about life in Rome, and connecting with the other guests was a very nice experience for me and my son (13). Warmly recommended!

I took my two teenage daughter and the three of us loved our evening! We learned a lot about making pasta and sauces, and enjoyed wonderful conversation with our hosts and other guests. We highly recommend this experience!
We had a great time at the cooking class. It was a fun social evening and we learned lots of good tips to make great homemake pasta.

Wonderful experience, despite being Italian myself I really enjoyed the class, Lucilla was a perfect host, the atmosphere was warm and friendly, I learned a lot and the food was very good, would totally recommend it!

The experience with Lucilla was excellent. We learned pasta recipes and sauces and chatted a lot with the other participants. Lucilla is very knowledgeable about the art of making pasta and has taught us a lot, always very friendly. We love it!!!

Lucilla's pasta making class was wonderful. She created a great atmosphere to relax and learn to make pasta. We made cheese and spinach ravioli with simple tomato sauce. And we made our favorite fettuccine alla carbonara. Both were absolutely delicious. We also really enjoyed sharing this experience with two beautiful couples, one from Northern Italy and one from Brazil. Even though we had four different languages between us we managed to get to know each other quite well. I highly recommend this class. I'm excited to make both dishes when I get back home. Lucilla ended the meal with the most delicious tiramisu. We were very satisfied.
Lucilla was incredibly warm and welcoming. Her and her husband knew their craft and welcomed us into their home. We had a great time and would definitely recommend.

The event was amazing as it was a create social atmosphere where everyone that attend could easily talk to each other and we learned a lot about making pasta. It was very fun and the social aspect was what really stood out.

This was a highlight of our Roman Holiday! Lucilla's instructions and hands-on teaching style made this evening educational and fun. We included our two teenagers, who also enjoyed the night. Lucilla & Renzo have a gorgeous apartment in a beautiful area we probably would not have had a chance to visit otherwise. They were gracious hosts, making strangers feel welcome and comfortable. And the pasta, wine and tiramisu was delicious! Thank you!!

Lucilla & Renzo her husband put on a fantastic night for us. They were star hosts in their fabulous city home. They ensured that a random
Group of strangers were pleasantly introduced to each other. As soon as we arrived we had traditional nibbles & wine, and the ingredients were excellent. We then made pasta - some into a ravioli and some into spaghetti, and two sauces.
It was fun, useful and educational.
Around the table we had a wide ranging discussion on world affairs - reflecting the clientele who happened to be there this evening - with a very stimulating variety of individuals.
All in all a lovely experience provided by excellent and very pleasant hosts. Diolch. Grazie.

Lucilla and Renzo, thank you so much for your kindness and hospitality. You created the perfect experience, and a wonderful sense of community for all of us. It was a pleasure enjoying cooking, food and great company in a totally unrushed atmosphere. Thank you for your hospitality and friendliness.

We had a excellent evening hosted by Lucilla and her husband. We made pasta and then two recipes (ravioli with a sauce and carbonara), which we then sat and ate together - they were both delicious! This was accompanied with wine throughout and finished off with homemade tiramisu! Would thoroughly recommend.

Lucilla and her husband were amazing. The handmade pasta making class was the highlight of my trip to Rome. It was fun talking with them and we got to eat what we made! I would definitely do this again.

We had a wonderful experience making home made pasta. So much fun! Lucilla and her husband Lorenzo made my family feel right at home, offering antipasto and wine, and finishing our dinner with a homemade dessert. We highly recommend spending time with Lucilla and making lasting memories.
Our experience with Lucilla was great! We really enjoyed our class. Lucilla is extremely warm, kind, and knowledgeable. We would recommend this class to others.

If you are looking for a real experience with local people and some in-depth knowledge of Roman culture you can't go wrong with this! Lucilla and her husband will make you feel like home while having a great time both cooking and talking. 100% recommended.

Lucilla and her husband were such amazing hosts!
We where in a group of 6 people. It was nearly like cooking and sitting together with friends. I can really recommend Lucilla's cooking lessons, because you don't only learn how to make pasta. You get to know new people, new cultures and a lot more.

Lucialla and her husband are wonderful hosts. They work together to make a seamless experience. She has us all aprons and little stations to make our pasta. It was interactive and super hands on. A time to remember always!!!
Great experience! Lucilla was wonderful as a host. She showed us many techniques. She is very passionate about good and enthusiastic about teaching others.

The pasta making class with Lucilla was amazing! We got to make 3 different types of pasta and they were all delicious. Lucilla and her husband were such kind people and very helpful throughout the experience. Definitely recommend when you are in Rome!
Lucilla is an awesome hostess! She went above and beyond in teaching us all she has. I learned so much in this experience! Highly recommended. It was a highlight of our visit to Rome!

Such a delightful evening learning how to make pasta! Lucilla and her husband warmly welcomed us in their home and shared their know how with passion in a relaxed atmosphere. I cannot recommend it enough!
Such a great experience with Lucilla and her husband. A great experience as a whole! We made two kinds of pasta from scratch and then ate together.

Probably the best expierence we had in Rome. The food was incredible and we learned so much about how to make pasta. It was also incredible to speak to native Italians who were equally interested in learning about us as we were learning about them. 100% cannot wait to return.
The pasta making course with Lucilla was a very interesting and fun experience. Thank you very much for answering all our many questions and teaching us all the tricks of making pasta! :-)

The evening with Lucilla and her husband was really good. We are greeted with a tray of cold meats and cheeses as well as wine (wine that is available all night, they do not count the number of glasses you take, which is very good). Lucilla showed us how to make the dough, how to cut it to form what we would eat. In addition, she also showed us how to make two sauces. Lucilla was attentive with all of us. Now I can say that I know how to make fresh pasta thanks to her! In the end, we ended up dinner with a homemade Tiramisu. Everything was really great and I would recommend this experience to anyone!!

Our pasta class was an amazing roman experience. Lucilla and her husband were very welcoming, caring and shared their passion and secrets for their family’s traditional pasta and gnocchi making. Proof will now be in the pudding when we recreate these great recipes at home :-). We truly had a fabulous time in their company. Grazie mille !

Lucilla and her husband welcomed us into their home for a once-in-a-lifetime pasta making class. We made spinach and ricotta ravioli with sugo finto sauce and spaghetti carbonara (a Roman classic!). Someone had previously expressed an interest in gnocchi, so she even gave us a quicker tutorial on that (when it is typically a separate class). She gave us a lot of great tips and shortcuts, i.e. if you don't have a pasta maker at home, what to do with ends/scraps of pasta, etc.

One person in our group was a vegetarian, and she was very accommodating in that regard. There were cooks of many different skill levels in the class, and she was a flexible, great teacher for all skill levels - even for the remedial cooks like myself. It was all very delicious!

She sends you the recipes afterwards so you can make them in your own home. I can't wait to! I don't think I will ever forget this experience! Thank you again, Lucilla.

I recommend this experience...We had a lovely evening.
Lucilla is very available and shares her expertise in a good mood.

I went with my 21 year old daughter to Lucilla. Lucilla and her Husband Enzo welcomed us warmly in their beautiful flat close to Castel Sant Angelo. At our arrival we were offered typical italian food delicacies such as antipasti and wine. We felt very welcomed. Preparing the pasta with Lucilla was an incredible experience. Each of us prepared their own pasta and she showed us how to cut the dough in 5 different types of pasta. Whilst Lucilla guided us friendly and patiently through the process, explaining every step in a way it almost seemed easy at the end. I feel comfortable enough to try it at home now! Eventually we prepared two different sauces (Carbonara and Amatriciana) and enjoyed these proudly with our homemade pasta.
We could notice that she make this with passion and knows how to share her knowledge with others. She had all the utensils prepared and was able to manage the time, so that we could enjoy the conversation, work together and in the end eat the pasta we have prepared. We finished with a beautiful plate of fresh fruits, delicious pastry and coffee. It was a incredible experience and we are coming again for the "gnocchis di patate" lesson ;)
I would warmly recommend this experience for anyone, who ist looking for a unique roman experience in the house of proper Italians.
